overview.description: The Harbor Active Small Cap Growth ETF (SGRW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in US small cap growth stocks. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation through equity investments SGRW was launched on Jan 14, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.
